report:
Behavior
- Repair only quoted values in the existing `token-assignment` rule. A closing quote terminates the credential only when it is not escaped; escaped quote characters remain inside the credential boundary.
- For `password="alpha \"beta\" gamma"`, redact the entire assignment through the true closing quote, preserving only unrelated following text.
- For `password="alpha beta`, treat the opening quote as an unmatched credential boundary and redact through the line end (or otherwise fail closed); no `alpha`, `beta`, or whitespace-delimited suffix may survive.
- Preserve current unquoted assignment boundaries and all other credential rules.

Owner
- `src/recorder/scanner.ts` owns the bounded scanning invariant. Extend the existing scanner/rule there; do not add a second scanner or promotion-specific sanitizer.
- `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts` owns both focused scanner regressions and the existing end-to-end promotion matrix.
- `dist/recorder/scanner.js` is regenerated output, not a second implementation.

Escape / unmatched law
- Inside a quoted assignment, escaped characters cannot close the quote; only an unescaped matching delimiter closes it.
- Once a recognized assignment opens a quote, absence of an unescaped matching delimiter before CR/LF is unsafe: consume/redact the entire remaining line or fail the scan. Never fall back to the unquoted branch and never emit a secret suffix.
- Keep CR/LF as the bound so malformed input does not swallow unrelated later lines.

Red
1. Add focused table cases around `scanString` for escaped embedded quotes and unmatched quotes (including suffix assertions, `token-assignment` hit assertions, and preservation of unrelated text after a genuinely matched quote). Retain simple single/double-quoted and unquoted controls.
2. Extend the existing category × credential promotion-path test with both concrete probes in accepted Receipt/promoted material; assert the full values and meaningful suffix markers are absent from every promoted file, receipt, manifest, and redaction report.
3. Run the focused test before implementation and capture that current behavior leaks `beta\\" gamma"` and leaves the unmatched assignment unchanged.

Green
1. Replace the current naive quoted alternatives with escape-aware matched-quote handling plus a line-bounded unmatched-quote fail-closed alternative, ordered before the unquoted fallback.
2. Run the focused scanner/promotion test pattern.
3. Run `npm run build:recorder`, then `npm run typecheck` and full `npm test`.
4. Confirm generated `dist/recorder/scanner.js` matches source behavior and the worktree contains only authorized files.

Scope / commit
- Expected files: `src/recorder/scanner.ts`, `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`, and regenerated `dist/recorder/scanner.js` (plus only build output proven to change).
- No README/schema/Soul/runtime API changes, no changes to other credential classes, no session inspection.
- Create exactly one forward commit from current HEAD, proposed title: `fix(recorder): close quoted assignment boundaries`. Commit body records root cause, escape/unmatched law, regressions, and verification. Return the resulting commit SHA and verification evidence in the apply Receipt.
